captions.detailed: A 3D model of a go-kart rear live axle assembly. It features a central steel axle shaft supported by two black cylindrical pillow-block bearing housings mounted to a black rectangular base plate. A dark grey drive sprocket with gear teeth is fixed to the middle of the shaft, and bright red wheel hubs with mounting studs are attached to both outer ends. The entire axle shaft, along with its attached sprocket and wheel hubs, rotates continuously relative to the stationary bearing blocks and base.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a go-kart rear live axle assembly using CadQuery. The assembly must include a central rotating axle shaft supported by two black pillow-block bearing cylinders on a mounting base, a dark grey sprocket in the center, and red wheel hubs at each end, allowing continuous rotation of the axle and its attached components.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed using an ArticulatedObject framework. First, a stationary base part is created by combining a rectangular box primitive for the mounting plate and two cylinder primitives for the bearing housings. Next, a single rotating axle part is defined, combining a long cylinder for the central shaft, a central sprocket wheel with outer teeth, and two red end-flange wheel hubs. Finally, a continuous joint is established between the stationary base and the rotating axle, aligned along the central longitudinal axis.
